author: tjeilmas
quote: Loved every second of my playthrough of Ocarina of Time on Switch 2. Its been many years since I played and beat OOT. I completed the game 100% yesterday. No complaints at all! The graphics were great. The puzzles were wonderful. A+ for the voice acting!
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: tjeilmas
quote: This game is an absolute blast! I played a bit of Splatoon 2, but I’m not the biggest Splatoon fan… I’m having so much fun with this game. It is difficult to put down. Easily a top 5 switch 2 game for me at this point!
